For λ≠0, A invertible and there are (q-1)|Sp(2m,q)| choices times q^{2m} functionals f, rank 2m+1. For λ=0, im A is totally isotropic r-space (0<=r<=m). Counting r-spaces by isotropic ordered independent frames and GL_r quotient yields I_{m,r}; surjective maps onto W contribute P_{m,r}; f in row(A) gives rank r for q^r choices and otherwise rank r+1 for q^{2m}-q^r. The resulting nonnegative polynomial has precisely claimed rank gap. Highest q-degrees 2m²+3m+1 and (5m²+5m)/2 differ by ((m-2)(m+1))/2, yielding density trichotomy.
